entries.headline: Built and merged browser-click v1 Chrome extension
entries.summary: Merged the first version of browser-click, a Chrome MV3 extension that lets users select visible page content, ask Claude about it in an in-page panel, continue conversations, add selections, use optional web search, and recover from errors. The implementation includes the options page, page-context extraction, streamed responses, Markdown rendering, tests, documentation, and a manual test checklist.

entries.headline: Added Claude Code plugin configuration and implementation skill
entries.summary: Merged repository configuration for the official Claude Code plugin marketplace and vendored the implement-spec skill, including its license, so the repository can load the skill during Claude Code sessions.
